channel.title: Daily Morning Briefing
channel.description: A personal daily news briefing, read aloud.
channel.itunes:author: Daily News Briefing

item.title: Briefing — Wednesday 30 September 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today: fifteen to twenty-two, showers, eight and a half millimetres of rain, so that is a proper umbrella, not a decorative one. Tomorrow, the first of October, the high drops to nineteen. Then it dries out, and every day to Monday tops out at twenty or under. Watch…

item.title: Briefing — Wednesday 23 September 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Day eight of the dry run, and I am officially out of new ways to gloat about it: thirteen to twenty-three today, partly cloudy, not a drop, wind you will not even notice. Jumper for the morning, gone by lunchtime. Thursday is much the same, high of twenty-two. Friday…

item.title: Briefing — Tuesday 29 September 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today: sixteen to twenty-five, partly cloudy, three millimetres of rain, so a shirt and an umbrella in the same bag. Wednesday is the wet one: nearly seventeen millimetres, still warm at twenty-three. Then the forecast gives up entirely. Thursday, Friday, Saturday,…

item.title: Briefing — Tuesday 22 September 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Right, listen. Seven consecutive dry days now, and today is the best of the run: twenty-five degrees, partly cloudy, not one drop of rain, barely any wind. Thirteen this morning climbing to twenty-five by afternoon. I do not trust it and neither should you — late…

item.title: Briefing — Thursday 24 September 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Nine days dry, and it's finally about to break — just not on the day we thought. Today: ten to twenty-one, partly cloudy, still not a drop, light jacket for the morning and that's it. Friday's the last good one, twenty-four and dry. Saturday eases to twenty, still dry.…

item.title: Briefing — Thursday 01 October 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today: twelve to nineteen, partly cloudy, seven tenths of a millimetre of rain. That is not rain, that is a rumour. Leave the umbrella; you will carry it anyway, because you are that man. It is also the first of October, the day gas bills jump a third on April, so…

item.title: Briefing — Sunday 27 September 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today: thirteen to twenty-three degrees, partly cloudy, two point four millimetres of rain — trivial, leave the big coat at home. Monday cools to ten to nineteen, dry. Then Tuesday, for no reason anyone bothered to explain, rockets to twenty-six degrees, six or seven…

item.title: Briefing — Sunday 20 September 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Twelve degrees at dawn, nineteen by mid-afternoon, clear sky, rainfall of exactly nothing. So you will leave the house in a coat and carry the bloody thing round all day like a man holding someone else's shopping. Layers. Jacket off at eleven.
And the week does not…

item.title: Briefing — Saturday 19 September 2026
item.description: Weather. Right, today is the wet one. Sixteen to twenty-one, cloud the colour of dishwater, six and a half millimetres of rain and wind up to eight metres a second, enough to turn an umbrella inside out. Waterproof, not the nice jacket. And then it stops. Completely. Not one…

item.title: Briefing — Monday 28 September 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today: eleven to nineteen degrees, partly cloudy, bone dry — mild and unremarkable, make the most of it. Tuesday jumps to a top of twenty-five but charges you nineteen millimetres of rain for the privilege. Wednesday is the one to actually dress for: still warm,…

item.title: Briefing — Monday 21 September 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Nine degrees at dawn. Twenty-one by mid-afternoon. Clear sky, no rain, no wind. Twelve degrees of swing inside one day, so the morning is Scotland in November and the afternoon is the south of France, and you have to dress for both using one body. You will leave…

item.title: Briefing — Friday 25 September 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Remember Monday, the day forecast last week to drown the whole run under fourteen millimetres of rain? It has since been revised right down to zero, the driest day of the week now, not the wettest — that is what a five-day outlook is worth. The dry run actually breaks…

item.title: Briefing — Friday 18 September 2026
item.description: Weather. One correction: there is a wet day left in this week after all, and it is Saturday. Today is bone dry. Not a drop. Cloud dawn to dusk, ten degrees now, nineteen by mid-afternoon, and a breeze so limp it barely qualifies. Jacket, no umbrella. Ten at breakfast, nineteen…

item.title: Briefing — Friday 02 October 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today: twelve to twenty, partly cloudy, and bone dry. Zero rain. You have no excuses and you know it. Saturday drips one point three millimetres, which is not weather, that is a cloud sneezing, so the plans stay on. Sunday: dry, twenty, the day every job you have been…
